founded.text: Established by William E. Pabor, who formed the Fruita Town and Land Company to sell town lots

timeline.text: The first permanent homesteaders settle in the Fruita area late in the year.
William E. Pabor establishes the town and forms the Fruita Town and Land Company. The town site was planned at 80 acres with a park in the middle.
